metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the two turnings of the glass, ten days to the fast, the week's sixpence, and the spoon found in the ink.

yesterday: The fast is ten days off. Ash Wednesday is the fifth of March.
The loaf is still a penny, and still short by a finger. Firing and washing is sixpence, entered once. Dinner was threepence.
The Sunday letter is still folded. It goes with Thursday's carrier.
After dinner the house was one spoon short. Alse found it in the ink, black to the neck. Mistress Ansell said it had been put there to be found.
